host.settingsUnavailable: This plugin settings tab is unavailable.

installed.activationRequired: installed by the agent — review and activate

empty.installedBody: Install a signed .zplugin package or open the Discover tab to browse the configured registry.
empty.updatesBody: No newer versions were found in the configured registry.

store.unavailableBody: The registry could not be loaded: {{error}}
store.configureBody: Configure a signed plugin registry URL in Settings → Plugins to browse installable plugins.

conflicts.title: Plugin contribution conflicts
conflicts.command: {{plugin}} and {{other}} both use the slash command {{value}}; the second one is disabled.
conflicts.hotkey: {{plugin}} and {{other}} both use the hotkey {{value}}; the second one is disabled.
conflicts.override: {{plugin}} and {{other}} both override {{value}}; neither override is applied until one is disabled.
conflicts.builtin: {{plugin}} uses {{value}}, which is reserved by a built-in command; the plugin command is hidden.

consent.description: Version {{version}} by {{publisher}}. Review the permissions before continuing.
consent.unknownPermission: Custom permission declared by the plugin.
consent.trustedWarningBody: Trusted plugins run JavaScript in the main window and can read or change anything the app can. Only install this if you fully trust the publisher.
consent.trustedConfirmMismatch: The plugin id does not match.
consent.keyChangedBody: This update is signed by a different publisher key. Confirm only if you expected a key rotation.
consent.keyConfirmLabel: Type {{id}} to accept the new key:
consent.keyConfirmMismatch: The plugin id does not match.
consent.criticalHint: This plugin requests {{count}} critical permission(s). A compromised plugin could access conversations, files or credentials.
consent.allowUnsignedHint: Unsigned packages have no publisher identity. Use only for plugins you built or reviewed.

detail.pluginUiOffTitle: Hidden by the plugin UI switch
detail.pluginUiOffBody: This plugin is installed and enabled, but Settings → Design has plugin UI turned off, so none of its interface is displayed.
detail.keepData: Keep plugin data, settings and secrets
detail.permissionsHint: Revoking any declared permission disables the plugin; grant it again and re-enable.
detail.noPrompt: This plugin injects no prompt text.
detail.logsHint: Logs, audited capabilities and agent tool calls for this plugin.
detail.secretsHint: Values are stored in secrets.json under this plugin's namespace and never returned to the plugin UI.

settings.title: Plugins
settings.description: Install third-party plugins that add pages, panels, commands, tools, skills, themes and providers. Untrusted code runs in a sandboxed iframe; trusted plugins run in the main window.
settings.enabledDescription: Turning this off unloads every third-party contribution and tool without deleting installed data.
settings.autoUpdateDescription: Check the registry and stage updates for plugins that opted in.
settings.trustedDescription: Trusted plugins run JavaScript in the main window with the app's privileges. Keep this off unless you fully trust the publisher.
settings.trustedConfirm: Trusted plugins can read conversations, files and credentials, and can change the interface. Enable trusted plugins?
settings.devDescription: Load unpacked folders and unsigned packages. Never leave this enabled for everyday use.
settings.safeDescription: Do not load any third-party plugin. Installed plugins and data are preserved so you can enable them one by one.
settings.registryDescription: Signed JSON indexes with plugins, versions, permissions and revocations. HTTPS is required; local paths work in developer mode. Separate multiple registries with commas or new lines.
settings.disableAllConfirm: Disable every plugin? Installed plugins and data are kept.
settings.footnote: Signatures identify the publisher; they do not make a plugin safe. Permission changes require a new consent.

safeMode.title: Safe mode is active
safeMode.body: Third-party plugins are not loaded. Use this recovery mode to enable plugins one by one.

uiDisabled.title: Plugin UI is turned off
uiDisabled.body: Sidebar tabs, pages, dock panels and slots contributed by active plugins stay hidden while this switch is off.

url.title: Install from URL
url.description: The package is downloaded and inspected before anything is installed. HTTPS is required.

errors.trustedPermission: This plugin is missing the `unsafe.renderer` permission.
errors.renderFailed: The {{name}} plugin UI failed to render. Disable or update the plugin.
errors.toggleFailed: Could not change the plugin state
